title: [Koyu Booking Link] - Entry Routing - External Link Opened - Activity Event List Shown First
description: AC 01.1 - State Transition Testing - Follow Jira and Figma flow where booking link lands on Activity Event List before any auth.
preconditions:
- Logged-in state: none (fresh app/browser session).
- Actor is Student or Parent user using Koyu booking link.
- Booking link points to Event Master EM-1001 with at least 1 published Activity Event.
- Reference design: Figma node 7593-44460 (https://www.figma.com/design/qmHa3rUESxPnfenYsKXbtv/-Eng--Event-Management?node-id=7593-44460&t=HtBSqAJUwV05Az5f-4).
steps_actions:
1. Open booking link URL in a new incognito/private session.
2. Read first visible header/title and event card area.
3. Observe UI state before touching Reserve.
steps_result:
1. Screen lands on Activity Event List, not Login/Sign up.
2. Activity Event List is visible with at least one event card ready for selection.
3. No blocking Login/Register screen appears before Reserve action.
steps_data:
1. booking_link = EM-1001; session = logged_out
2. expected_first_screen = Activity Event List; min_cards >= 1
3. auth_gate_timing = reserve_only

title: [Koyu Booking Link] - Event Browsing - List Item Opened - Event Detail Visible Without Login
description: AC 01.2 - Display Completeness - User can browse Event List and open Event Detail pre-login as defined in proposed booking-link flow.
preconditions:
- Continue from logged-out booking-link session.
- Event List contains Event A and Event B under EM-1001.
- Reference design: Figma node 7593-44460 (https://www.figma.com/design/qmHa3rUESxPnfenYsKXbtv/-Eng--Event-Management?node-id=7593-44460&t=HtBSqAJUwV05Az5f-4).
steps_actions:
1. Tap Event A card from Activity Event List.
2. Validate detail content for booking decision.
3. Return to list and open Event B.
steps_result:
1. Event A detail opens directly with no auth redirect.
2. Event title, date/time, location, and Reserve button are visible and readable.
3. Event B detail also opens without forced login.
steps_data:
1. selected_event = Event A
2. required_fields = title,date_time,location,reserve_button
3. selected_event = Event B

title: [Koyu Booking Link] - Pre-login Display - Event List Cards - Mandatory Fields Rendered
description: AC 01.2 - Component Testing - Pre-login list cards keep required fields and support detail navigation for discovery flow.
preconditions:
- Logged-out booking-link session is active.
- Activity Event List has at least 3 events with distinct schedule values.
- Reference design: Figma node 7593-44460 (https://www.figma.com/design/qmHa3rUESxPnfenYsKXbtv/-Eng--Event-Management?node-id=7593-44460&t=HtBSqAJUwV05Az5f-4).
steps_actions:
1. Open booking link and wait until list render completes.
2. Inspect each sampled card on list view.
3. Tap each sampled card to detail and navigate back.
steps_result:
1. At least 3 event cards are rendered.
2. Each card shows event name and date/time with no missing core text.
3. Card-to-detail navigation works and still does not trigger login before Reserve tap.
steps_data:
1. min_cards = 3
2. mandatory_card_fields = name,date_time; sample_size = 3
3. navigation_mode = card_tap; auth_gate = reserve_only
